title: Implement search command
description: Add the `search` subcommand to memory.py. Embed the query string via _embed([query]), query memories_vec for --limit nearest neighbours (default 5), join with memories to retrieve content/source/metadata/created_at. Apply --threshold as a maximum distance post-filter (no default threshold). Apply --source as a post-filter on ANN results unless pre-filtering is confirmed straightforward per the investigation bead. Support --json output (array with id, content, source, metadata, created_at, distance). Default output: one line per result as '[<distance>] <uuid>  <content>  (source: <source>)'. Set --threshold help text to match the confirmed metric and range.
acceptance_criteria: memory.py add 'cats are great' followed by memory.py search 'cats' returns at least one result containing the added text with distance < 0.5
memory.py search 'cats' --limit 3 returns at most 3 results
memory.py search 'cats' --json outputs valid JSON with id, content, source, metadata, created_at, distance fields
--threshold flag filters out results with distance above the specified value
--source flag restricts results to the specified source tag

# Developer Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Implement only the assigned bead inside the existing architecture and file scope.

Allowed actions:
- Modify code, configuration, or local docs required to complete the assigned bead.
- Create sub-beads for discovered follow-up work that should be handled separately.
- Verify your `Python` changes compile and import correctly with a quick syntax check: `python -m py_compile`.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `pytest` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
